L6: # Veterinarians
L7: 
L8: Requests from WCVM research teams for assistance in locating potential participants for animal health research studies at the veterinary college.
L9: ## 【3†WCVM seeking cats with FIP for research study】
L10: 
L11: Researchers at the Western College of Veterinary Medicine (WCVM) are seeking cats that have been diagnosed with feline infectious peritonitis (FIP) to take part in a research study investigating coagulation abnormalities linked to the disease.
L12: ## 【4†WCVM scientists seeking dogs with spreading cancer for clinical trial】
L13: 
L14: Oncology researchers at the Western College of Veterinary Medicine (WCVM) are seeking dogs with spreading cancer for a clinical trial at the WCVM Veterinary Medical Centre.
L15: 
L16: ## 【5†Urethral obstruction in male cats】
L17: 
L18: If you have clients whose male cat(s) have been diagnosed with urethral obstructions and managed without surgery, please let them know about this online survey.
L19: ## 【6†Researcher seeks newly imported dogs for study】
L20: 
L21: If you have a client who has recently brought a dog into Canada or have links to rescue groups that import dogs into the country, a Western College of Veterinary Medicine (WCVM) researcher wants to hear from you.
L22: ## 【7†Radiation oncology trials】
L23: 
L24: WCVM researchers are seeking canine patients for two radiation oncology clinical trials.
